items.a1: clinIQ is a clinic operations platform that adds real-time patient flow management, digital check-in, RTM billing automation, and pre-authorization tracking on top of your existing EHR. It is not a replacement for your EHR — it is the operational layer your EHR was never built to provide.
items.q2: How long does it take to go live?
items.a2: Most clinics are fully operational within 3–5 business days. EHR connection is same-day for supported systems. Staff training takes under two hours.
items.q3: Will it work with my EHR?
items.a3: clinIQ integrates with all major EHR systems including Epic, athenahealth, eClinicalWorks, Cerner, NextGen, AdvancedMD, and Tebra. If yours is not on that list, ask us — we likely have a connector or can build one.
items.q4: What is RTM billing and how does clinIQ automate it?
items.a4: Remote Therapeutic Monitoring (RTM) is a set of Medicare and commercial payer CPT codes (98975–98981) that allow clinics to bill for monitoring patients between visits using connected devices or apps. clinIQ identifies eligible patients, tracks compliance minutes automatically, and routes billing codes to your billing team or clearinghouse.
items.q5: What does RTM billing pay per patient?
items.a5: Most clinics average $120–$150 per RTM-enrolled patient per month. A 50-patient RTM panel generates approximately $6,000–$7,500 in additional monthly revenue — with minimal added staff workload.
items.q6: How does the digital check-in work?
items.a6: Patients receive an SMS or email before their appointment. They complete intake forms, insurance verification, and consent on their smartphone — before they arrive. When they walk in, front desk check-in takes under 60 seconds.
items.a7: clinIQ pulls procedure and payer data from your schedule, submits prior auth requests electronically, and tracks approval status in a single dashboard. Denials trigger automatic appeal workflows. You stop chasing approvals.
items.a8: Yes. clinIQ is built to HIPAA standards with end-to-end encryption, role-based access controls, and a signed BAA for every clinic. All data is stored and transmitted within HIPAA-compliant infrastructure.
items.q9: How is clinIQ different from our EHR?
items.a9: Your EHR is a medical record and billing system. clinIQ is an operations platform. EHRs track what happened — clinIQ manages what is happening right now: who is waiting, who is with a provider, which RTM patients are compliant this month, which prior auths are pending. These are different jobs.
items.a10: Pricing is based on clinic size and modules selected. Most clinics recover the full cost within the first month through RTM billing alone. Request a demo and we will put together a specific ROI projection for your patient volume.

about.title: An ACO in a Box — built for independent clinics.
about.subtitle: clinIQ brings the operational infrastructure of an Accountable Care Organization to independent practices that can't afford enterprise healthcare software.

mission.heading: Our Mission
mission.body: Independent clinics deliver the majority of care in the United States — and they're being squeezed from every direction. Insurance reimbursements down. Administrative burden up. Staff burnout accelerating. clinIQ exists to level the playing field. We give independent practices the same operational firepower as large hospital systems — without requiring them to replace their EHR, hire a team of consultants, or spend 18 months on implementation.

vision.heading: The Vision
vision.body: An ACO in a Box means every clinic — regardless of size — has real-time patient flow visibility, automated revenue capture, and pre-authorization compliance built in. Not bolted on after the fact. Not sold as ten separate tools. One platform, configured for your specialty, live in days.

page.problemP1: Most clinics run on five or six disconnected tools. One system for check-in, another for scheduling, spreadsheets for tracking patient flow, paper clipboards for intake forms, and whatever workaround the front desk invented to keep things moving. Each tool solves one problem and creates three more.
page.problemP2: Revenue leaks through the gaps. RTM codes go unbilled because nobody has time to track compliance. Pre-authorization requests sit in purgatory while surgical revenue evaporates. Staff spend 13 to 15 hours per week on prior auth paperwork alone — time that should go to patients.
page.problemP3: Patient experience suffers too. Check-in takes eight minutes instead of three. Wait times stretch because nobody knows who’s actually in the lobby. Patients leave without scheduling follow-ups because the process is too painful. And everyone — staff and patients — feels the friction.
page.pain1: 13–15 hrs/week lost to prior auth paperwork at the average specialty practice.
page.pain2: $144K/year in RTM revenue most practices are not billing.
page.pain3: 8 minutes average check-in time. clinIQ cuts it to under 3.
